source: DHM Islamic Studies Level 1 (ISLB A1) · lesson 2. Exercises reused from the lesson.

learn.en: Allah is Al-Khaliq, The Creator. He made everything around us.
learn.title: The Creator

learn.en: Imagine a time when there was nothing at all: no sky, no earth, no animals. From nothing, Allah made everything.
learn.title: Before the beginning

learn.en: He made the sky, the sun, the moon and the stars, the land, mountains, rivers and oceans.
learn.title: The universe and the Earth

learn.en: He made trees and flowers, elephants, lions, dogs and soft little kittens — and gave birds the ability to fly.
learn.title: Life and beauty

learn.en: A builder needs wood and bricks to make a house. People “make” things from materials Allah created, but only Allah creates from nothing.
learn.title: Making vs creating

learn.en: “Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators of themselves?” (Qur'an 52:35)
learn.title: The Qur'an asks us to think

learn.en: When we see Allah's beautiful world, we thank Him by saying Alhamdulillah.
learn.title: Say thank you

quiz.en: True or false? A human can create a real, living kitten out of absolutely nothing.
True or false? Before Allah created the universe, there were already trees and oceans everywhere.
True or false? We can use things Allah created (like wood and metal) to make toys and houses.
Who made the earth, the oceans and the animals from completely nothing?
When Allah created the trees and mountains…
opts: He needed to buy wood and bricks
He created them out of absolutely nothing
He asked humans to help Him

think.q: Look out of the window. Find three things that Allah created, and one thing that people made from Allah's materials.
think.a: Allah created the sky, the trees and the birds. People made the window glass — from sand that Allah created!

parents.summary: Al-Khāliq: Allah created everything from nothing; people only make things from what Allah created.
parents.tip: On a walk, take turns pointing at things and saying who created them.
